sentences.en: But dare I say, reading people's Around the Towns is another dainty delight.
sentences.zh: 不过我敢说，读大家的“城中热事”是另一种精致的乐趣。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Way to bring it full circle, lady.
sentences.zh: 圆得真漂亮，这位女士。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好啦。

sentences.en: This is from Louise F.
sentences.zh: 这封信来自苏格兰的

sentences.en: from Scotland, who said,
sentences.zh: 路易丝·F，她说，

sentences.en: Hey, office ladies.
sentences.zh: 嘿，办公室女士们。

sentences.en: I have always wondered, what would happen if someone was the main focus of an episode one week,
sentences.zh: 我一直很好奇，如果某个人是一周某集的主要焦点，

sentences.en: but when it came to filming, they were so ill that they couldn't come to set?
sentences.zh: 但在拍摄时，他们病得太重而无法来到片场，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: Would the episode be rewritten or filmed a different week?
sentences.zh: 这集会被重写，还是会在另一周拍摄？

sentences.en: Surely, with the amount of episodes you guys filmed, this was bound to happen at some point.
sentences.zh: 当然，考虑到你们拍摄的剧集数量，这在某种程度上是不可避免的。

sentences.en: Oh, Louise.
sentences.zh: 噢，路易丝。

sentences.en: Oh, Louise.
sentences.zh: 噢，路易丝。

sentences.en: Louise, Louise, first of all, hi from Scotland.
sentences.zh: 路易丝，路易丝，首先，来自苏格兰的问候。

sentences.en: I love Scotland.
sentences.zh: 我爱苏格兰。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I just had to say that.
sentences.zh: 我只是得说这个。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Because I went there for my honeymoon.
sentences.zh: 因为我度蜜月时去过那里。

sentences.en: You know how much I love Scotland.
sentences.zh: 你知道我多爱苏格兰。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好啦。

sentences.en: Now I'm going to focus.
sentences.zh: 现在我要集中注意力了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 所以情况是这样的。

sentences.en: We had to just go to work anyway, basically, is the short answer.
sentences.zh: 简短的回答是，基本上我们无论如何都得去上班。

sentences.en: There are so many moving parts and so many people involved in pulling an episode together that if it was written and planned and there was a shoot schedule,
sentences.zh: 筹备一集节目需要协调的环节和人员实在太多了，如果剧本已经写好、计划好并且有了拍摄日程，

sentences.en: it was very hard to undo that.
sentences.zh: 要推翻它是非常困难的。

sentences.en: And yes, every once in a while it happened.
sentences.zh: 是的，这种事偶尔确实会发生。

sentences.en: Like, if someone was truly too sick to come to set, we might rearrange some of the week's schedule to give them an afternoon off or a morning off or maybe the whole day off.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果有人病得实在太重无法来片场，我们可能会重新调整当周的日程，给他们放个下午假、早上的假，或者干脆放假一天。

sentences.en: But it was very difficult and very rare.
sentences.zh: 但这非常困难，也非常罕见。

sentences.en: It was very rare.
sentences.zh: 真的非常罕见。

sentences.en: They would try to, like Jenna said, move the schedule so maybe you could go home early, you know, pull up someone else's talking heads, things like that.
sentences.zh: 就像珍娜说的，他们会尽量调整日程，也许能让你早点回家，你知道的，把其他人的单人采访提前，诸如此类。

sentences.en: But mostly we just muscled through it.
sentences.zh: 但大多数时候，我们都只能咬牙挺过去。

sentences.en: The only time I remember us doing a big switcheroo was Dwight's speech because Rain was so, so sick.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们唯一一次做重大调整是在拍《德怀特的演讲》时，因为雷恩病得太重太重了。

sentences.en: And he was the focus of that episode.
sentences.zh: 而且他正是那一集的焦点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And we had to film at that hotel.
sentences.zh: 而且我们必须在那家酒店拍摄。

sentences.en: And that was one time I remember I got a call from our AD and they were like, okay, the hotel has been canceled.
sentences.zh: 那是少数几次我记得接到副导演电话，他们说，好吧，酒店的拍摄取消了。

sentences.en: We're moving things around.
sentences.zh: 我们要调换一下日程。

sentences.en: Rain's going to the doctor.
sentences.zh: 雷恩要去医院看医生。

sentences.en: He's too sick.
sentences.zh: 他病得太厉害了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But really, I mean, you could probably count on one hand the number of times that happened.
sentences.zh: 但说真的，我的意思是，这种情况发生的次数大概一只手都数得过来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: There were sometimes like life events, like a death in the family.
sentences.zh: 有时候会遇到一些生活大事，比如家里有人去世。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And I remember we made space for people, obviously, to go grieve and be with their families.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们当然会腾出时间让大家去哀悼、去陪伴家人。

sentences.en: But if someone was sick, you had to kind of just power through.
sentences.zh: 但如果有人生病了，你基本上就得硬挺过去。

sentences.en: I mean, I had false labor and went to work the next day.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我假宫缩过，第二天照样去上班。

sentences.en: I was in the hospital and they called.
sentences.zh: 我当时在医院，他们还打电话来。

sentences.en: Remember?
sentences.zh: 记得吗？

sentences.en: Ken Svornack was like, Angela, are we having this baby tonight?
sentences.zh: 肯·斯沃纳克（Ken Svornack）当时说：“安吉拉，我们今晚要生孩子吗？”

sentences.en: Because it was the next day where Andy proposes and the Ferris wheel and all that.
sentences.zh: 因为第二天就是安迪求婚、摩天轮和所有那些戏份。

sentences.en: And I was like, I'll let you know.
sentences.zh: 我说：“我随时向你汇报。”

sentences.en: I totally remember that.
sentences.zh: 我完全记得那件事。

sentences.en: And listen, this is not exclusive to The Office.
sentences.zh: 而且听着，这不仅仅是《办公室》这部剧独有的。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: This is the entertainment industry.
sentences.zh: 这就是整个娱乐行业。

sentences.en: When I did the movie Walk Hard, John C.
sentences.zh: 当年我拍电影《永不退缩》时，约翰·C·

sentences.en: Reilly got really sick.
sentences.zh: 赖利（John C. Reilly）病得很重。

sentences.en: I think he had like a strep throat or something.
sentences.zh: 我想他好像得了链球菌性咽喉炎什么的。

sentences.en: And we had to do like a whole makeout scene anyway.
sentences.zh: 但我们无论如何还是得拍一场完整的吻戏。

sentences.en: And then I got sick and I got so sick that I lost my voice.
sentences.zh: 然后我也病了，病得很重，甚至失声了。

sentences.en: I had laryngitis.
sentences.zh: 我得了喉炎。

sentences.en: I couldn't speak.
sentences.zh: 我说不出话来。

sentences.en: And I was really sick.
sentences.zh: 我病得真的很厉害。

sentences.en: And they were like, you still have to come to work.
sentences.zh: 结果他们说：“你还是得来上班。”

sentences.en: I'm like, how?
sentences.zh: 我说：“怎么去？”

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么去？

sentences.en: I can't speak.
sentences.zh: 我都说不了话。

sentences.en: They're like, we're going to shoot some stuff where you're not talking today.
sentences.zh: 他们说：“我们今天拍一些你不用说话的镜头就行了。”

sentences.en: I mean, it's like you're going to just show up.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就好像你必须得露面一样。

sentences.en: It is pretty bonkers.
sentences.zh: 这确实挺离谱的。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And we're kind of laughing because I think in hindsight, sometimes you look back at those
sentences.zh: 我们在笑是因为我觉得事后回想起来，有时候你看着那些

sentences.en: moments, you're like, what?
sentences.zh: 时刻，会想：什么鬼？

sentences.en: But it does involve so many moving parts and so many people that they are just constantly
sentences.zh: 但因为其中包含太多运转的环节和太多的人，他们总是在

sentences.en: trying to make sure they make their day and get something shot because they have a limited
sentences.zh: 努力确保能赶上进度、拍完镜头，因为他们有着有限的

sentences.en: time and a limited budget.
sentences.zh: 时间和有限的预算。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And there is like this element of the show must go on.
sentences.zh: 而且确实有一种“演出必须继续”的成分。

sentences.en: And that's been a part of, you know, actors.
sentences.zh: 这也是你知道的，演员的一部分。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: For all time, the show must go on.
sentences.zh: 一直以来，演出必须继续。

sentences.en: And there is that spirit when you're making a movie or you're making a TV show.
sentences.zh: 当你拍电影或拍电视剧时，确实有那种精神。

sentences.en: And I think I famously told the story of how incredibly sick I was one week at the office
sentences.zh: 我想我曾出名地讲过那个故事：在办公室的那一周我病得有多厉害，

sentences.en: and I took a bunch of Sudafed.
sentences.zh: 我吃了一堆伪麻黄碱。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I could make it through.
sentences.zh: 好让我能撑过去。

sentences.en: And didn't Greg say it was one of your best performances?
sentences.zh: 而且格雷格不是说那是你最好的表演之一吗？

sentences.en: Greg.
sentences.zh: 格雷格。

sentences.en: Like reach out to your agent or something?
sentences.zh: 比如联系你的经纪人或者别的什么？

sentences.en: He called my manager and was like, Jenna was incredible today.
sentences.zh: 他给我的经纪人打电话说，珍娜今天表现太棒了。

sentences.en: Incredible.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: You're like, I was super Sudafed it up.
sentences.zh: 你当时就想，我当时吃了超级多的伪麻黄碱。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm like, oh, I don't know what that says.
sentences.zh: 我就想，哦，我不知道这说明了什么。

sentences.en: But anyway, thank you for that question.
sentences.zh: 不过无论如何，谢谢你提出这个问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: We juSt.
sentences.zh: 我们只是。

sentences.en: We just powered through.
sentences.zh: 我们只是硬着头皮坚持了下来。

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 我们确实做到了。

sentences.en: Well, everyone, this was such a fun episode.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，这真是一期非常有趣的节目。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家的收听。

Amazing.
